versions.changelog:
- Establishes an end-to-end Material Design 3 workflow, from user goals and information architecture through adaptive layout, components, states, accessibility, and review.
- Adds guidance for semantic tokens, component selection, responsive and foldable layouts, system UI, and accessible interaction states.
- Makes M3 Expressive optional and purposeful, with safeguards against common “Material-looking” UI anti-patterns.
- Directs users to official Material guidance and task-specific reference files; exact file changes are unknown.
